justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No RCT evidence of superior patient outcomes; diagnostic accuracy advantage possible but not well-studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS exam plus 2,000 hours clinical experience requirement; major career investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to the broadest rehabilitation caseload; outpatient orthopedics is the most common PT setting.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No OCS-specific billing premium in most payer contracts; some health systems offer differential pay or referral preference.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Most-held ABPTS certification (~40,000 holders); frequently required or preferred in outpatient PT postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients may prefer credentialed clinicians; confidence in expert care is meaningful.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Ortho cash-pay exists (manual therapy, performance), and OCS lends credibility, though it's not a consumer-facing brand.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Allows modest premium positioning vs generalist PTs in ortho-heavy markets.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Common enough among ambitious ortho PTs that differentiation is moderate, not elite.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Reproducible skillset — you can hire other OCSs and build an ortho cash-pay practice around it.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't ask for OCS, but referrers and savvy patients recognize it.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires either residency or significant clinical hours plus exam — meaningful time cost.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Gold-standard credential for ortho faculty; heavily weighted in promotion and hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: OCS holders publish frequently in ortho/manual therapy journals.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly aligned with core DPT ortho curriculum — extremely useful.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying ortho PT literature is among the deepest in the profession.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Routinely listed as required or strongly preferred in ortho faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: ABPTS process is rigorous but well-established; reasonable cost relative to academic payoff.
